subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear permanently replace the dedicated Agent and Session pages with Home controls and ship the `model-controls` Phone/Wear protocol capability?
rationale: The patch is a product-navigation redesign coupled to a companion protocol contract; tests and proof establish behavior, but they cannot determine the intended long-term Wear information architecture.

options.title: Accept the consolidated Home workflow
options.body: Confirm the three Home controls and capability-gated model protocol as the intended Wear UX, then proceed once the remaining required checks cover the reviewed head.

options.title: Keep a dedicated context page
options.body: Request a narrower navigation design if compact Home controls should not replace the existing Agent and Session pages.

recommendation.title: Accept the consolidated Home workflow
recommendation.body: Confirm the three Home controls and capability-gated model protocol as the intended Wear UX, then proceed once the remaining required checks cover the reviewed head.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the recent protocol and state-safety hardening that defines the decision surface.
